title: Jesus... I'm Staying Back For Diwali And Everyone's Gone Home
topic: his first Diwali away from home, staying back while everyone goes home and pretending he prefers the quiet

bible.text: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... everyone's booking tickets home for Diwali. Why am I pretending I like the quiet? 🪔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: My PG is almost empty already. First Diwali away from home.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You said you like the quiet. You refreshed your train app four times today.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Flights cost too much this month. Amma would sell her earrings to fix that.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: She doesn't want your money spent on guilt. She wants your voice on the phone.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So I tell her I'm not coming? That's one hard phone call.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Make it. She'll pray louder for you than any lamp will glow this year.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what's Diwali in an empty room with nobody's doorway open?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Light one lamp where you are. A festival doesn't need a full house to be real.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You are the light of the world. Even a city of one needs its light tonight.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: First festival away from home too? What would you light first? 👇
